title: Acyclicity of a bit block
statement: Let $a,b,c,cin,acc,L$ be natural numbers, with each of $a,b,c,cin,acc$ strictly less than $L$. The gate list formed by the specified full-adder gates, followed by the specified XOR gates and two final gates, is acyclic starting from index bound $L$.
caveat: The exact gate wiring is given by upstream constructions whose informal descriptions are stubs.
